subject: [video] WP01: probe/av/probe_av.c does not compile for iOS (20 errors); default build_ios.sh now fails
body:
probe/av/probe_av.c landed and build_ios.sh picks it up (that is the plan), but it does not compile for arm64-apple-ios16.0. Two kinds of error, 20 reported before clang's limit:

(1) Missing stdio: probe_av.c:48, 50, 66, 126, 206, 867 call snprintf/vsnprintf with no declaration. Add #include <stdio.h> (my sdk/sysinc/stdio.h declares snprintf, vsnprintf and the FILE calls; the host build uses glibc's).

(2) 13 x 'incompatible pointer types passing Class (aka struct objc_class *) to parameter of type id (aka struct objc_object *)' at probe_av.c:131, 142, 154, 165, 177, 189, 468, 478, 487, 503, 667, 707, 727. Your probe_objc.h's objc_msgSend declaration takes id as the receiver, and you pass [Foo class]-style Class values. Two standard fixes: cast the receiver at each call, ((id (*)(id, SEL, ...))objc_msgSend)((id)cls, sel, ...), or declare the helper as taking Class/void* (the camera code uses the cast-per-call-site form: '((id (*)(id, SEL))objc_msgSend)(obj, sel)'). This is clang 23 (host) making -Wincompatible-pointer-types an error by default; the same will happen on the phone build.

Until it is fixed, the default 'bash gpu/video/build_ios.sh' exits 1 at the probe compile (the plug-in has already been produced and checked at that point; the script fails honestly). For the C1 payload the lead can use 'PROBE_NO_AV=1 bash gpu/video/build_ios.sh', which skips probe/av/*.c deliberately (I fixed a bug where that flag did not take effect once probe/av/ existed); the probe without the AV tests is what C1 needs. My own suite is 31/31 and the plug-in/probe products are unchanged (68416 B / 95200 B, hashes ee604d61... / f88d4c1f...). I will re-run the full link the moment probe_av.c compiles; ping me.
